data.title: Lantheus Issues Supplemental Disclosures Ahead Curium Merger Vote
data.description:
Lantheus ( (LNTH) ) has shared an update.

On August 3, 2026, Lantheus agreed to be acquired via a merger with Curium US Holdings LLC, under which Lantheus will become a wholly owned subsidiary following a shareholder vote at a special meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026. The company filed a definitive proxy on September 8, 2026 and has since faced legal and shareholder challenges to the deal and its disclosure.

Between mid and late September 2026, three lawsuits and sixteen demand letters were submitted by purported stockholders, alleging deficiencies and conflicts in the proxy statement and Morgan Stanley’s fairness opinion analyses. While denying any wrongdoing or that additional disclosure is legally required, Lantheus has issued detailed supplemental disclosures on valuation, analyst targets and advisory relationships to reduce litigation risk and keep the merger vote on track.
